pressroom.hero.title: Pressroom
pressroom.hero.subtitle: Find media resources, key facts, and press contacts for the Paris Institute for Advanced Study.
pressroom.keyFacts.title: Paris IAS at a glance
pressroom.keyFacts.whatWeAre.title: What we are
pressroom.keyFacts.whatWeAre.body: The Paris Institute for Advanced Study is an international research institution rooted in the humanities and social sciences, partnered with leading higher education and research establishments in Paris and Île-de-France.
pressroom.keyFacts.mission.title: Our mission
pressroom.keyFacts.mission.body: We develop high-level international research, host world-class scholars, and convene academics, the general public, and decision-makers to address current and future societal challenges.
pressroom.keyFacts.location.title: Location
pressroom.keyFacts.location.body: Situated on the Île Saint-Louis in the heart of Paris, our historic building at 17 Quai d'Anjou offers a unique environment for interdisciplinary exchange.
pressroom.mediaKit.title: Media Kit
pressroom.mediaKit.description: Download our media kit for logos, photography, and editorial guidelines. All assets are ready for print and digital use.
pressroom.contact.title: Get in touch with our press team
pressroom.contact.description: For media enquiries, interview requests, or additional materials, our communications team is available to assist you.
visit.title: Plan your visit
visit.subtitle: Located on the historic Île Saint-Louis in the heart of Paris, we are easy to reach by public transport.
visit.parking-note: Parking is very limited on Île Saint-Louis. We recommend using public transport. If you need to drive, nearby commercial car parks are available.
visit.rer-note: 10 min walk across Pont Saint-Louis or Pont de la Tournelle.
visit.bike-note: Several Vélib' bike-share stations are located nearby, including on Quai d'Anjou and Quai de Bourbon.
visit.ratp-planner-body: Use the official RATP journey planner to find the best route to 17 Quai d'Anjou from anywhere in Paris.
visit.island-body-1: The Paris Institute for Advanced Study is housed in a 17th-century hôtel particulier on the Île Saint-Louis, one of two natural islands in the Seine at the heart of Paris.
visit.island-body-2: The island is a haven of calm just steps from Notre-Dame Cathedral, the Marais, and the Latin Quarter — making it an exceptional setting for scholarly exchange.
contact.hero.title: Get in touch
contact.hero.subtitle: Whether you need a video, a media breakthrough, an event organization, a plan to change science, or to change the world — our team is here for you.
contact.team.label: Our team
contact-or-visit.title: Contact or visit us
contact-or-visit.subtitle: Whether you want to get in touch with our team or come and see us on the Île Saint-Louis, you'll find everything you need here — from direct contacts to directions.
support.meta.title: Support Us — Paris IAS
support.meta.description: Support the Paris Institute for Advanced Study through individual giving, corporate patronage, or foundation partnership.
support.hero.title: Support Paris IAS
support.hero.subtitle: Every contribution enables the free pursuit of ideas that matter. Join individuals, foundations, and corporations who believe in the power of independent research.
support.why.title: Why your support matters
support.why.body: Advanced research requires time, freedom, and the right environment. Paris IAS provides exactly that — a singular place where exceptional scholars from across the world are given the space, resources, and intellectual community to ask the questions that others cannot. Your support makes that possible.
support.why.stat1.label: researchers welcomed
support.why.stat2.label: nationalities represented
support.why.stat3.label: academic partner institutions
support.why.stat4.label: public events per year
support.individuals.title: Individual giving
support.individuals.body: Individuals who share our commitment to free inquiry and the advancement of knowledge are invited to support Paris IAS through a direct donation. Donations fund new fellowships, expand our public programme, and help us welcome the most talented researchers — regardless of their country of origin or discipline.
support.individuals.tax.title: Tax benefits (France)
support.individuals.tax.note: A fiscal receipt is issued within one month of receipt of contribution.
support.individuals.how.title: How to give
support.individuals.how.online.label: Online — by credit card
support.individuals.how.cheque.label: By cheque
support.individuals.how.cheque.payable: Made payable to « IEA de Paris »
support.individuals.how.wire.label: By bank transfer
support.corporate.title: Corporate & institutional partnership
support.corporate.body: Paris IAS welcomes partnerships with companies, foundations, and institutions that wish to associate their name with excellence in independent research.
support.corporate.benefit1.title: Scientific visibility
support.corporate.benefit1.body: Associate your brand with a prestigious international research institution.
support.corporate.benefit2.title: Societal impact
support.corporate.benefit2.body: Support cutting-edge research with measurable impact on global challenges.
support.corporate.benefit3.title: Public engagement
support.corporate.benefit3.body: Access our annual programme of 100+ events open to the public.
support.corporate.tax.label: Corporate tax deduction
support.corporate.tax.note: of donation amount, capped at 0.5% of pre-tax revenue (impôt sur les sociétés).
support.foundations.title: Foundations & legacy giving
support.foundations.body: Paris IAS accepts gifts from private foundations and welcomes discussions around legacy giving and planned philanthropy. For institutions wishing to establish a named fellowship or fund a dedicated research programme, we are happy to explore tailored arrangements.
support.contact.title: Get in touch with our partnerships team
support.contact.description: To discuss a donation or partnership, or to receive further information, please contact our philanthropy team directly.
support.contact.name: Nadège Bourgeois
support.legal: Paris IAS is a registered non-profit association under French law (loi 1901). All donations are fully compliant with applicable fiscal legislation.
